source_caveats.result: A 200×50 jbeech homepage image is a contact-details graphic with a small seal, not a standalone wordmark; intentionally omitted. The prior ProModeler and dev ProModeler direct URLs returned HTTP 403. No bypass was attempted. No high-resolution standalone wordmark was identified in this bounded review.

A goodservo.com page self-identifies as Shenzhen Feetech and displays a 600×200 PNG whose decoded pixels exactly match the manufacturer-domain header (ImageMagick compare absolute error count 0). The domains were not independently established as under common ownership, so the differently hosted duplicate was discarded and the manufacturer-domain file retained. A nontruncated recursive listing of the pinned official wiki commit found only the previously recorded feetech-logo-white.svg among paths containing logo or brand.

Leomotion GmbH is a separate entity, not automatically interchangeable with Leomotion Drives AG. The AG English homepage directly links leomotion.com as its Swiss RC shop; that storefront identifies itself as Leomotion GmbH. A public 2023 Leomotion GmbH announcement states that electric-motor production was transferred to Leomotion Drives AG and describes the GmbH as its Swiss RC distribution channel. The GmbH storefront directly links a 752×47 path SVG (4 paths, no embedded image), but this is the GmbH storefront logo: do not recommend it as an AG variant without explicit brand/rights verification. This research copy was discarded.

The manufacturer homepage links the gfprops.com store, whose directly linked 1807×462 PNG decodes to exactly the same pixels as the previously retained manufacturer-header PNG (ImageMagick compare absolute error count 0); the different encoded response was discarded. The Chinese site header is a smaller version of the same mark and was also discarded. No stronger independent logo was identified.
Homepage continues to link the previously captured orange path-only SVG; no new meaningful variation identified. No duplicate was downloaded.
